- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Prep the Hair - Start by washing and conditioning the hair, then blow dry it using a round brush to create a smooth and sleek finish.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Section the Hair - Divide the hair into three sections: top, middle, and bottom. Use clips to keep each section separate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Cut the Top Section - Take the top section of hair and cut it to the desired length for the pixie cut. Use scissors or clippers to create a choppy, layered look.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Cut the Middle Section - Take the middle section of hair and cut it to a slightly shorter length than the top section. Again, use scissors or clippers to create a choppy, layered look.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Cut the Bottom Section - Take the bottom section of hair and cut it to a shorter length than the middle section. Use scissors or clippers to create a choppy, layered look.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 6: Cut the Bangs - Take the front section of hair and cut it to the desired length for the bangs. Use scissors or clippers to create a choppy, layered look.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 7: Blend the Layers - Use scissors or clippers to blend the layers together, making sure to create a seamless transition from one layer to the next.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 8: Style the Hair - Use a texturizing spray or sea salt spray to add volume and texture to the hair. Use a round brush to style the bangs and a flat iron to smooth out any flyaways.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 9: Finish the Look - Apply a light hold hair spray to keep the hair in place, and you're done! Your new pixie cut with bangs like Jenna Ortega is complete.
